# Research Swarm Ledger (cycle-310)

Shared state for the master deep-research cron ("queen") + spawned worker crons. The queen appends NEW finds here
and spawns a worker for each actionable one; workers update their row to DONE and self-delete. DEDUP against this
list every fire ? never re-spawn a source already listed.

## Affinity ? p-scale rule (use `src/pxr/affinity.py`)
ANY potency in molar (IC50/EC50/AC50/Ki/Kd/Km) ? `to_p(value, unit)` = -log10[M] ? same scale as pEC50. Already-log
(pIC50/pKd/pChEMBL) pass through. kcat = rate, NOT p-convertible (use kcat/Km as weak feature only). Measured AND
synthetic/co-folded data both welcome ? log which.

## WORKER PROTOCOL (the queen spawns one cron per actionable find; worker runs ~hourly until DONE, then self-deletes)
For source S:
1. PULL metadata/index only first (subset-download; route to C:/pxr_work; D: full). Gated HF ? token is stored; if 403 log "needs accept".
2. NORMALIZE all potency cols to p-scale via src/pxr/affinity.py. Map target ? UniProt; filter for PXR/NR1I2 (O75469) + nuclear receptors.
3. COVERAGE TEST (the gate, cycles 300/301): max Tanimoto of S's relevant compounds to our 513 test. If median < ~0.4 and no NR1I2 rows near test ? log "no coverage" and mark DONE (negative).
4. If coverage OR a usable pretrained model/embedding: CURATE (standardize SMILES, dedup InChIKey, drop dup vs train), then test BOTH mechanisms ? (a) as extra training rows / AUXILIARY MULTITASK HEAD in chemprop (the RyeCatcher mechanism that actually lifts), (b) as a featurizer/embedding. Honest clean-holdout gate (nb1127 style) + corr-with-nb3200-ERROR. NEVER the 253.
5. If beats deployed best (C:/pxr_work/search/best_ensemble.json, currently 0.4451) ? build submission + update best_ensemble.json + bank to memory.
6. Mark the ledger row DONE (+result), then CronList ? find self by name ? CronDelete. STOP.
RULE: only marginal-over-deployed on the HONEST gate counts. Binding?activation caveat (cofold/docking signal-less for pEC50). GPU via molab/`hf jobs run`/Explorer/Colab/Kaggle when needed.

FOD is none of these.) The fractional occupation density (Grimme/Bauer, JCTC 2017) runs a single finite-electronic-temperature (Fermi-smeared) GFN2-xTB or DFT single-point so frontier orbitals get FRACTIONAL occupations; the FOD then maps WHERE static (multireference / "hot", thermally-accessible) electron density sits, and its integral **N_FOD** is a single scalar quantifying a molecule's static-correlation / "reactive-electron" content / incipient-diradical character. This is a DISTINCT observable from the ground-state HOMO-LUMO gap + Mulliken charges the queued tblite/g-xTB row emits (those are zero-temperature single-determinant reads; FOD is the finite-T multireference diagnostic) and from every density-TOPOLOGY (QTAIM/ELF/NCI) and reactivity (Fukui/E-N) row.
